common_errors.symptom: Compilation error: 'class juce::SmoothedValue<float>' has no member named 'setRampLength'
common_errors.root_cause: JUCE 7.0 changed SmoothedValue API - use reset(sampleRate, rampTimeSeconds)
common_errors.fix: Replace smoothedValue.reset(sr); smoothedValue.setRampLength(time); with smoothedValue.reset(sr, time);
common_errors.prevention: Use JUCE 7.0 API: reset(sampleRate, rampTimeSeconds)

common_errors.symptom: error: use of deleted function 'juce::dsp::FFT::FFT()'
common_errors.root_cause: juce::dsp::FFT has no default constructor, must be created with order parameter
common_errors.fix: Use std::unique_ptr<juce::dsp::FFT> fft; and fft = std::make_unique<juce::dsp::FFT>(order); in prepare()
common_errors.prevention: FFT and similar DSP objects need unique_ptr when members

common_errors.symptom: Audio thread allocation warnings, potential glitches
common_errors.root_cause: std::vector.resize() or new in audio callback
common_errors.fix: Pre-allocate all buffers in prepareToPlay(), use reserve() for vectors
common_errors.prevention: Check processBlock for any allocations, move to prepareToPlay()

common_errors.symptom: Stack overflow on some DAW thread stacks
common_errors.root_cause: C-style arrays on stack: float tempRe[numBins] where numBins is large
common_errors.fix: Make arrays member variables, allocate in prepare()
common_errors.prevention: Avoid C-style arrays in processBlock, use pre-allocated member arrays

common_errors.symptom: Audible zipper noise during parameter automation
common_errors.root_cause: Calling getNextValue() once and using result for entire block
common_errors.fix: Call getNextValue() inside the per-sample loop, or use isSmoothing() check for block optimization
common_errors.prevention: Pattern: for each sample { auto val = smoothed.getNextValue(); } NOT: auto val = smoothed.getNextValue(); for each sample { use val; }

common_errors.error: Delay line reads return same sample every iteration
common_errors.symptom: Phase cancellation, wrong output
common_errors.root_cause: Delay line read() returns buffer[writePos - delay] which is constant during block
common_errors.fix: Read at writePos - delay - i for walking backward through buffer, or use process() method
common_errors.prevention: Delay line must account for samples written during block

common_errors.symptom: Path A output too quiet
common_errors.root_cause: Texture coefficient applied in split stage AND inside module
common_errors.fix: Apply coefficient once - either in split or inside module, not both
common_errors.prevention: Trace signal flow, check each gain stage doesn't multiply unexpectedly

common_errors.error: Latency compensation wrong at non-48kHz rates
common_errors.symptom: Phase misalignment at 96kHz/192kHz
common_errors.root_cause: Hardcoded latency in samples, not accounting for internal resampling
common_errors.fix: spectralLatencySamples = fftSize * decimationFactor (query from spectralEngine)
common_errors.prevention: Always compute latency from actual processing, account for sample rate conversion

common_errors.symptom: Clicks at block boundaries when resampling
common_errors.root_cause: Counter declared as local variable in process()
common_errors.fix: Make counter a member variable, reset only in reset()
common_errors.prevention: State that persists across blocks must be member variables

common_errors.symptom: Clipping at DAW with high output gain
common_errors.root_cause: Gain applied after tanh limiter, output can exceed [-1,1]
common_errors.fix: Move gain before limiter, or add final clamp(-1,1)
common_errors.prevention: Ensure final output is always clamped to [-1,1]

common_errors.error: RMS tracking shared between L/R channels
common_errors.symptom: Envelope jumps between channels
common_errors.root_cause: Single envelope member updated alternately by L and R
common_errors.fix: Track per-channel RMS or compute mono RMS before per-sample loop
common_errors.prevention: State for stereo processing must be per-channel or pre-computed

common_errors.symptom: Rare crashes, parameter flickering
common_errors.root_cause: std::set modified from GUI thread, read from audio thread
common_errors.fix: Use std::atomic<bool> flags per parameter, or lock-free queue
common_errors.prevention: Any state touched by both threads needs atomic or lock-free sync

common_errors.symptom: Click when enabling effect after bypass
common_errors.root_cause: if (bypass) return; skips filter processing, stale state
common_errors.fix: Always process filters; only skip the effect output or crossfade
common_errors.prevention: Filters must always process to maintain state, bypass only affects output

common_errors.symptom: Unnecessary CPU usage
common_errors.root_cause: Constant coefficients computed inside per-sample loop
common_errors.fix: Compute once before loop, store in member or local variable
common_errors.prevention: Move invariant computations outside loops

FFT.description: Fast Fourier Transform for spectral processing

patterns.name: FFT as member (JUCE 7.0)
Process block

dsp_catalog.name: FastMath
dsp_catalog.algorithm: Padé approximants for fast tanh and atan

parameters.fastTanh: Input: float. Output: float in [-1.05, 1.05]. Accurate within 3% for |x| < 2.
parameters.equalPowerCrossfade: Returns {dry, wet} gains where dry² + wet² = 1

dsp_catalog.cpu_cost: ~5-10x faster than std::tanh, suitable for per-sample use
known_issues: Overshoots by ~5% at extreme values (|x| > 20)
Not suitable for applications requiring exact bounds

dsp_catalog.name: DCBlocker
dsp_catalog.sample_rate_handling: Coefficient computed in prepare(): coeff = exp(-2π * 5 / sampleRate)
known_issues: Needs ~100ms to settle on DC offset change
5Hz cutoff means it removes DC but passes all audio

dsp_catalog.name: DelayLine
dsp_catalog.cpu_cost: O(1) per sample - buffer read with linear interpolation
known_issues: Must use process() method for per-sample delay, not read() in loop
writePos advances with each process() call

dsp_catalog.name: TextureBodyDetector
dsp_catalog.algorithm: Dual envelope followers (fast 2ms/80ms, slow 80ms/400ms) + spectral flux
dsp_catalog.cpu_cost: Envelope: O(1) per sample. FFT: O(N log N) every hopSize samples.
known_issues: FFT requires unique_ptr in JUCE 7.0
performRealForward replaced by perform()

dsp_catalog.name: Waveshaper
dsp_catalog.algorithm: Soft (tanh-based) and hard (atan-based) curves with drive control

parameters.drive: 0-1, where 0 = bypass, 0.5 = blend of soft/hard, 1 = maximum hard curve

known_issues: Must bypass at drive < 0.001 to avoid numerical issues
Latency compensation needed for parallel paths

dsp_catalog.name: SpectralDroneEngine
dsp_catalog.algorithm: FFT-based spectral processing at 48kHz internal rate with sample rate conversion
dsp_catalog.cpu_cost: O(N log N) per FFT, every hopSize samples
known_issues: decimCount must be member variable, not local
Latency = fftSize / 2 * decimationFactor
FFT needs unique_ptr, not direct member

dsp_catalog.name: ChorusEnsemble
dsp_catalog.sample_rate_handling: Delay times in ms, computed from sample rate
dsp_catalog.cpu_cost: 4 delay reads + 4 LFO calculations per sample
known_issues: kBaseDelaysMs should be constexpr std::array for ODR-use
Always process to maintain state, bypass only affects output mix

dsp_catalog.name: ResonantFilter
dsp_catalog.algorithm: TPT State Variable Filter with auto-gain compensation
dsp_catalog.sample_rate_handling: Coefficients computed from sample rate and cutoff
known_issues: Auto-gain: 1/sqrt(Q) compensation for resonance
No denormals produced at high resonance

dsp_catalog.name: DriveCircuit
dsp_catalog.algorithm: 3-stage drive with adaptive pre-gain, saturation, and tone tilt

parameters.drive: 0-1, bypass at 0, warm at 0.5, grit at 1

dsp_catalog.sample_rate_handling: Tone filter coefficients computed once in process(), not per sample
known_issues: RMS tracking must be per-channel or pre-computed mono
Tone tilt uses separate state for L/R

dsp_catalog.name: StereoWidener
dsp_catalog.algorithm: LR2 crossover at 250Hz, M/S processing for highs

parameters.width: 0-1, where 0 = no widening, 1 = tripled side signal

dsp_catalog.sample_rate_handling: Crossover coefficients computed from sample rate
known_issues: Always process crossover filters, skip only M/S widening when width=0
LR2 = two cascaded Butterworth stages

dsp_catalog.name: ModulationEngine
dsp_catalog.sample_rate_handling: LFO phases computed from sample rate
known_issues: Envelope needs separate attack (10ms) and release (100ms) coefficients
LFOs ring-modulated: A×B→C, B×C→A, C×A→B

failure_modes.symptom: SmoothedValue compilation error: no member named 'setRampLength'
failure_modes.fix: Use reset(sampleRate, rampTime) instead of reset(sr); setRampLength(t);
failure_modes.prevention_rule: CHECKLIST: Use JUCE 7.0 SmoothedValue API: reset(sampleRate, time)

failure_modes.symptom: FFT compilation error: no default constructor
failure_modes.root_cause: juce::dsp::FFT requires order parameter in constructor
failure_modes.fix: Use std::unique_ptr<juce::dsp::FFT> and make_unique in prepare()
failure_modes.prevention_rule: CHECKLIST: FFT and similar DSP objects need unique_ptr when members
CHECKLIST: No allocations in processBlock - all buffers pre-allocated

failure_modes.root_cause: C-style arrays on stack in processBlock: float temp[size]
failure_modes.fix: Make arrays member variables, allocate in prepare()
failure_modes.prevention_rule: CHECKLIST: No large stack arrays in processBlock

failure_modes.root_cause: SmoothedValue.getNextValue() called once per block, not per sample
failure_modes.prevention_rule: CHECKLIST: SmoothedValue must use getNextValue() per sample OR check isSmoothing() for block optimization

failure_modes.root_cause: Delay line read() returns same sample during block iteration
failure_modes.fix: Use process() method or read at writePos - delay - i
failure_modes.prevention_rule: CHECKLIST: Delay line reads must account for samples written in current block

failure_modes.root_cause: Gain coefficient applied twice: in split stage and inside module
failure_modes.fix: Apply coefficient only once in signal chain
failure_modes.prevention_rule: CHECKLIST: Trace all gain stages, ensure no unintended multiplication

failure_modes.root_cause: Hardcoded latency not accounting for internal resampling
failure_modes.fix: Compute latency from actual processing: fftSize * decimationFactor
failure_modes.prevention_rule: CHECKLIST: Query latency from each module, account for sample rate conversion

failure_modes.symptom: Clicks at block boundaries when resampling
failure_modes.root_cause: Decimation counter declared local in process(), resets each block
failure_modes.fix: Make counter a member variable, reset only in reset() method
failure_modes.prevention_rule: CHECKLIST: State that persists across blocks must be member variables

failure_modes.symptom: Output clips when output gain is high
failure_modes.root_cause: Gain applied after tanh limiter, can exceed [-1,1]
failure_modes.fix: Move gain before limiter OR add final clamp
failure_modes.prevention_rule: CHECKLIST: Final output must be clamped to [-1,1]

failure_modes.root_cause: Single RMS envelope updated by alternating L/R samples
failure_modes.fix: Compute mono RMS before loop OR use per-channel envelopes
failure_modes.prevention_rule: CHECKLIST: Stereo processing state must be per-channel or pre-computed

failure_modes.root_cause: std::set modified from GUI thread, read from audio thread
failure_modes.fix: Use std::atomic<bool> flags or lock-free queue
failure_modes.prevention_rule: CHECKLIST: Any state touched by both threads needs atomic or lock-free sync

failure_modes.symptom: Click when enabling effect after bypass
failure_modes.root_cause: if (bypass) return skips filter state update, filters stale
failure_modes.fix: Always process filters, only skip the effect output or crossfade
failure_modes.prevention_rule: CHECKLIST: Filters must always process to maintain state

failure_modes.root_cause: Constant filter coefficients computed inside per-sample loop
failure_modes.prevention_rule: CHECKLIST: Move invariant computations outside loops

failure_modes.root_cause: Using getParameters() instead of APVTS for state save/restore
failure_modes.fix: Use apvts.getRawParameterValue() and apvts.getParameter() in tests
failure_modes.prevention_rule: CHECKLIST: APVTS handles state; test round-trip save/restore

failure_modes.root_cause: Not accounting for FFT hop size and resampling
failure_modes.prevention_rule: CHECKLIST: Query latency from each module that introduces it

failure_modes.root_cause: JUCE GUI requires GTK development libraries
failure_modes.fix: sudo apt install libgtk-3-dev, or remove GUI from test target
failure_modes.prevention_rule: CHECKLIST: Install GTK dev packages, or use minimal modules for tests
